actions.name: ab-profiles
actions.title: AB profiles
actions.description: Run this Speedometer profiling task for two Firefox builds in one task on the same machine, so that machine differences affect the comparison less. Both builds must exist and be finished. The base build must come from a tree with the same or a higher trust level, so try can compare against autoland but not the other way around.

base_revision.title: Base revision
base_revision.description: Full 40-character revision of the push whose build should be compared against this one. Ignored if a base build task id is given.

base_project.title: Base project
base_project.description: Project (branch) the base revision was pushed to.

base_build_task_id.title: Base build task id
base_build_task_id.description: Task id of the build to compare against. Overrides the base revision, for cases where the build cannot be looked up from a push (a build from an action task on another repository, say).

order.title: Run order
order.description: Which side to run first. The machine is warmer for the second run, so triggering the action twice with both orders and comparing the pairs separates that effect out.

build_number.title: The release build number

previous_graph_ids.description: Optional: an array of taskIds of decision or action tasks from the previous graph(s) to use to populate our `previous_graph_kinds`.

version.description: Optional: override the version for release promotion. Occasionally we'll land a taskgraph fix in a later commit, but want to act on a build from a previous commit. If a version bump has landed in the meantime, relying on the in-tree version will break things.

next_version.description: Next version. Required in the following flavors: ['ship_devedition', 'ship_firefox']

partial_updates.description: Partial updates. Required in the following flavors: ['promote_devedition', 'promote_firefox', 'push_devedition', 'push_firefox', 'ship_devedition', 'ship_firefox']

release_partner_build_number.description: The partner build number. This translates to, e.g. `v1` in the path. We generally only have to bump this on off-cycle partner rebuilds.

release_partners.description: A list of partners to repack, or if null or empty then use the current full set
